span: A defendant against whom an ex-parte decree is passed has two options
why: Headnote says the defendant has two remedies but that a petition under Order IX Rule 13 is not maintainable once an appeal is dismissed; it also records that the ex-parte decree was liable to be set aside on defective service. Headnote confidence is capped.

span: there is no bar on unsuccessful defendant adopting both the remedies simultaneously

span: a party may apply to the Court for setting aside the same for reasons satisfying the Court regarding non-appearance
why: Court's own reading of Order IX Rule 13 that a defendant against whom an ex-parte decree is passed may apply to set it aside on proof of reasons for non-appearance.
